steps.note: Open the prepared live Tech+RFQ project on the buyer side.
Withdraw the whole project through the project menu with the required reason.
Verify Procol records the project as withdrawn.
Open the History tab where withdrawn projects should appear.
Verify this prepared project appears in History.
Inspect the withdrawn event from the vendor portal.
Open the event's technical stage in the vendor portal.
Verify the vendor sees the technical stage as withdrawn.
Open the event's pricing stage in the vendor portal.
Verify the vendor sees the pricing stage as withdrawn.
